statement.zh: 现代综合将晚前王朝至早王朝上埃及中心（如希拉孔波利斯、阿拜多斯/提尼斯区、纳伽达）与下埃及/三角洲遗址（如布托）讨论为物质文化与制度建构的互动网络——而非单次征服叙事。
statement.en: Modern syntheses discuss late Predynastic–Early Dynastic Upper Egyptian centers (e.g. Hierakonpolis, Abydos/Thinite region, Naqada) and Lower Egyptian/Delta sites (e.g. Buto) as interacting networks of material culture and institution-building—not as a single battle-conquest narrative.
